svg.title: Six-bit parity three ways
svg.desc: Three threshold networks for six-bit parity side by side, each checked on all 64 inputs. Left, the DNF network: 32 hidden AND units, one per odd-weight input pattern (five are drawn, with an ellipsis), feeding an OR output; 33 units, 224 connections, depth 2. Middle, the counting network: six hidden units c1 to c6 with biases −1 to −6 reading all inputs with weight 1, and an output with alternating weights +1 and −1 and bias −1; 7 units, 42 connections, depth 2. Right, a tree of five three-unit XOR blocks pairing (x1,x2), (x3,x4), (x5,x6), then the first two results, then that result with the carried z3; 15 units, 30 connections, depth 6.
svg.text: 32 AND units, one per odd row
each pill: the one row it accepts
cₖ = θ(x₁+⋯+x₆ − k), k = 1…6 from the top
each ⊕ adds two layers; z₃ waits
Same function on all 64 inputs; the sizes differ because the constructions differ.
